DitherAreaChart.categories: The label of every point on the x axis.
DitherAreaChart.series: The areas, each { label, color, values, low, high, dashed }. Later series draw in front.
DitherAreaChart.stack: none: the areas overlap, each from the baseline. stacked: each sits on the ones before it. percent: stacked and scaled to 100%.
DitherAreaChart.level: Gradient only: coverage of the densest band, just under the line, 0 to 1.
DitherAreaChart.smooth: A smooth curve that never overshoots, or straight segments.
DitherAreaChart.axes: Show the axes, the readout and the legend spotlight.
DitherAreaChart.tooltip: Show the axes, the readout and the legend spotlight.
DitherAreaChart.interactive: Show the axes, the readout and the legend spotlight.
DitherAreaChart.animated: The chart is drawn in from the left when it appears.
DitherAreaChart.unit: Written after every value. Values are shortened to 1.2K.
DitherAreaChart.chart-height: Height of the chart, axes included.
